authorization_scope: CPU evidence audit and experiment design only; no training, GPU work, base asset modification or shutdown performed.

fixed_assets.a6: Accepted M2 asset remains frozen. Record its content hashes before any future benchmark.
fixed_assets.persistent_road: A single world-space surface/material/marking asset with the same parameters in keep and delete modes.
fixed_assets.photometric_parent_warning: Existing native B, environment, road initialization and coarse/fine calibration used same-scene RGB. Their target information is not removed merely by holding out camera views or suppressing output rows.

data_scope.supplied_sensor_evidence: Indexed protobuf samples raw0/102/137/198 contain all five camera images/calibrations and all five LiDAR sensors with two compressed returns. This four-record audit is not an all199 sensor-completeness audit.
data_scope.required_all_input_ledger: Enumerate every available (raw,camera) before a full all-supplied-RGB claim. Missing image, invalid calibration, unknown height, sparse depth and untested camera remain explicit unknown states.
data_scope.LiDAR_scope: Original reader combines five LiDAR sensors x two returns with TOP motion compensation and NLZ filtering. FRONT cache retains only nearest FRONT-FOV cloud returns plus a separately stored ground pool; that cache is not a full surround occlusion map.

evidence_states.definition: Same world patch has a camera projection with measured geometric support, no positive foreground conflict, sufficient image quality, and >=3 mutually agreeing real RGB observations under a fixed rule.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Use real observations, repair rejected eligibility or representation/visibility integration first.
evidence_states.caveat: Radiance consistency is a clean-reference proxy, not independently measured unshadowed albedo.

evidence_states.definition: At least one verified real RGB observation exists, but count, span, sharpness or color consistency fails the stable-reference threshold.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Retain source identity and confidence; seek other frames/cameras or robust fitting. Never relabel as never-visible.

evidence_states.definition: Actual sensor ground/road returns support surface position or normal, but no verified usable RGB sample exists in the audited input scope.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Use geometry as a declared depth-only constraint; appearance remains unknown.

evidence_states.definition: A plausible world road surface projects inside an audited camera, with positive front-surface or conservative box-blocking evidence. RGB is occluded in that view.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Search every other input view; prior is eligible only after the scope-level search, not from a single view's occlusion.
evidence_states.caveat: An annotated box provides approximate occlusion evidence; it does not prove an exact dense physical silhouette.

evidence_states.definition: A sufficiently certain world surface is behind or unambiguously outside every tested camera frustum.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Report not imaged by the audited scope. Do not generalize from FRONT199 to all supplied cameras.

evidence_states.definition: No accepted sample and no complete positive occlusion/out-of-FOV accounting; includes conservative 2D guard rejection, sparse depth, quality gates, untested cameras and missing records.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Collect or compute missing evidence. Any prior output is an uncertain hypothesis rather than proof of never-visible necessity.

evidence_states.definition: Road height, normal or ray/surface intersection lacks adequate measured support or has incompatible geometry.
evidence_states.allowed_action: Do not assign a precise world patch or make a visibility claim. Propagate a height interval or obtain geometry.

never_visible_claim_contract.unit: Fixed world patch on a road surface with a documented geometry uncertainty interval, not an image-space hole.
required: Freeze world patch, spatial guard, input scene, time indices, complete camera roster and calibrated pixel convention.
Check projection of the full finite patch and its height uncertainty in every available input camera/time, including lens distortion and relevant pose/timing uncertainty.
For in-frustum opportunities require positive foreground occlusion evidence or an explicit lack of sufficient confidence. Sparse absence of LiDAR is not occlusion proof.
Record separate per-view flags: frustum state, image availability, geometry confidence, annotation-box blocker, measured front surface, guard, image quality and RGB acceptance/reject cause.

Only state no usable RGB observed under the audited scope when no verified RGB witness exists. A stronger never-visible statement is conditional on complete frustum/occlusion accounting with no unresolved views.
Report all-out-of-FOV, all-occluded and unresolved cases separately. Missing sample count alone is never sufficient.
never_visible_claim_contract.current_conclusion: No existing source_valid array supplies enough negative evidence to certify all199x5-camera never-visible road patches.

masked_holdout.purpose: A controlled missing-road benchmark with sealed real RGB ground truth; this is distinct from naturally unknown road completion.
masked_holdout.patch_definition: Choose nonoverlapping finite world-surface patches using geometry/visibility and predeclared material strata (plain asphalt, solid paint, dashed paint, seam/edge or curvature where present). Freeze IDs, metric bounds and seed before evaluating any completion.
masked_holdout.guard: Dilate each patch in world space for geometric/calibration uncertainty, interpolation and filtering footprints, and finite Gaussian support. Predeclare the guard. Mask before every feature encoder; a small guard does not remove information already embedded by a global encoder.
input_blinding: For every available input camera/time, remove RGB rays that can intersect target+guard over its allowed height interval, before any resizing, sharpening, photometric statistics, feature extraction or model inference.

Keep original RGB target pixels in a separate read-only evaluation store unavailable to fitting, candidate generation, validation or model selection. Never black-fill and then label that black region as negative road evidence.

Rebuild all same-scene appearance initialization, source RGB tensors, upper-cluster references, fused road colors, texture atlases, SH features, native/environment appearance, global/coarse/fine calibration fields and scene-conditioned prior features from the blinded inputs.

For existing learned scene models either refit the necessary appearance state from blinded inputs or exclude that model from the strict no-target-information track. Masking its final output is insufficient.
Invalidate caches by a content hash covering original scene identity, world patch, guard, camera masks and blinding stage. Taint every downstream artifact that depends on an unblinded target.

Mask or remove Gaussian/surfel contributions whose finite footprint crosses target+guard even when their centers lie outside it. Recompute interpolation and neighboring calibration without target colors.

Prior prompts, reference images, retrieval examples, embeddings, point colors and preview thumbnails must come from blinded inputs. Candidate selection may use visible context and predefined constraints, never target GT.

Any generic pretrained weights are frozen and provenance-recorded. Same-scene finetuning or memorized target conditioning must be declared; suspected training-set overlap cannot be silently treated as clean external knowledge.

geometry_tracks.appearance_blind_depth_known: Permit real geometry-only LiDAR support inside target, identical in every arm; remove all target RGB from every source and derivative. This tests missing appearance with measured geometry.
geometry_tracks.geometry_and_appearance_blind: Additionally withhold target+guard ground returns, geometry supervision and geometry initialization, then reconstruct from surrounding support or prior. Do not compare it directly to the depth-known track without labeling the difference.
geometry_tracks.mask_generation_note: If evaluation-only geometry is used to define exact masks, isolate that geometry from fitting except in the explicitly depth-known track.

masked_holdout.split: World patches are the statistical split unit. Hold out complete patches across all views; reserve separate validation patches for settings. View holdout alone leaves the same target visible in other images and is not sufficient.
masked_holdout.candidate_selection: Use a fixed prior-candidate budget and seed, with scoring only on allowed surrounding RGB, geometry, material and marking continuity. Seal test GT until final evaluation.
arms: Real-observation recovery oracle with full source access: upper bound, outside the blinded comparison.
Blinded real context only: geometry-aware interpolation/material fit, no pretrained completion.
Pretrained candidates only projected to the shared world surface, no real-context fit.
Pretrained candidates followed by the same allowed real-context fit and persistent shared-world optimization.
masked_holdout.controls: Identical patch manifests, geometry track, cameras, allowed RGB budget, optimization budget and rendering pipeline across comparable arms. Audit overhead, smoke and engineering replay are itemized separately.

proposed_representation.surface: A local 2.5D road height field or mesh anchored to actual LiDAR, with measured support and uncertainty; no unconstrained flat plane in unsupported regions.
proposed_representation.appearance: World-shared asphalt material/texture plus marking curves or a semantic marking layer on the same surface. Tie visible and completed segments through continuity and material constraints.
proposed_representation.prior: Generate multiple context-conditioned material/marking candidates, project them into the world surface, reject geometric/marking discontinuities, then fit against allowed real observations outside blinded or naturally unknown regions.
proposed_representation.observation_priority: When an actual patch is observed in any supplied input, use those real observations. Completion priors address the verified absent-RGB or explicitly blinded portion only.
proposed_representation.persistent_rendering: Register the fitted road once with provenance and confidence. Render it in the ordinary depth/opacity ordering in both keep and delete; no edit-time hallucination or screen-space patch substitution.
proposed_representation.frozen_actor: No a6 M2 weight, geometry, opacity, ownership or row identity changes. Above-road foreground and retained vehicles remain in the depth ordering.

evaluation.valid_reference: Score only sealed real RGB pixels with measured geometric visibility and documented photometric qualification. Unknown hidden centers have no invented pixel GT.
evaluation.denominators: Report total patch area/cells, geometric support, RGB-witnessed area, scored pixels and pixel-frames, visible source frames/cameras, target/guard excluded counts and unresolved area. Provide per-patch macro and pixel-weighted aggregates.
evaluation.appearance: Linear-RGB MAE and sRGB PSNR; SSIM only on valid supported windows. Report asphalt and marking strata separately, including marking location, width and endpoint continuity where GT supports them.
evaluation.geometry: Measured depth/normal errors in the declared geometry track; height uncertainty and geometry failure counts remain separate from appearance scores.
evaluation.multi_view: Fixed world-patch reprojection consistency and temporal stability in all specified views, with image-angle/depth bins.
evaluation.integration: Actual joint road alpha*T, standalone alpha, environment/static/road contribution accounting, residual foreground occlusion, seam damage, and protected-region changes in both keep/delete. High standalone alpha cannot substitute for joint contribution.
evaluation.asset_consistency: Hash and exact-compare frozen a6 M2/base parents and persistent road state between keep/delete; render with the current timestamp rather than a global timestamp override.
evaluation.acceptance: Preregister thresholds against a baseline and validation patches before opening sealed test GT. No quality-accepted claim is made by this design file.

existing_holdout_audit.what_is_held_out: These nine views are skipped only when caching the added calibration residual fit.
existing_holdout_audit.remaining_target_paths: Road RGB/geometry were built from all199; same-scene native parents remain; fine coefficients are initialized/regularized around the accepted coarse field. Coarse/fine fields are not rebuilt under world-patch blinding.
existing_holdout_audit.valid_claim: A diagnostic of an additional calibration fit at withheld camera views.
existing_holdout_audit.invalid_claim: Strict extrapolation into road appearance absent from all input RGB or independent clean-road test GT.

future_execution_gate.current_run: No future benchmark training authorized or started by this audit.
future_execution_gate.before_long_run: For any >=about1h approved experiment, run about10min smoke in the real environment including forward/backward, finite loss, memory, loading, checkpoint save, evaluation, full optimizer/RNG/sampler restore and entry to the next stage. CPU tests do not replace this smoke.
future_execution_gate.budget: Keep the agreed scientific method, samples, learning rate and formal step budget unchanged; separately account for smoke and engineering replays.
